surviving_new.laconic: Serious about the frivolous, and utterly frivolous about the serious.

surviving_new.laconic: Masculinity staged as anxious, theatrical display under threat of failure.

surviving_new.laconic: A foundational early memory secretly shapes a character's whole destiny.

surviving_new.laconic: A son contends with the father over the mother's place.

surviving_new.title: The Body Made Spectacle For The Gaze
